format: NDCA Sanctioned events, 1:00 a.m. cut-off and per-couple penalty

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: The last final of the evening must take the floor before 1:00 a.m.; the organizer is penalized a per-couple amount for every round of every event taking the floor after 1:00 a.m., distributed by the organizer to the impacted couples on the day they dance.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must project the 1:00 a.m. boundary (monitoring), flag a proposal that plans a final after it (preventable violation, acknowledgment and reason) and record, as facts, each round that actually took the floor after 1:00 a.m. (round, heat, count of non-scratched couples, local timestamp, rule reference). The penalty is between the organizer and the couples: DanceFlow never computes, displays as owed, stores or charges a currency amount.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Design only; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: SQL, migrations, UI, notification, activation. Needs the time model and the event time zone. A test must assert that no money value is ever written.
interpretation_notes: NOT IMPLEMENTED and a profile blocker. 'Evening' and the day boundary are not defined (Q2). The staff compensation recommendation in III.D.1.a(1)(a) is not modelled.
decision_refs: OD-26 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: controlled, audited mid-event running-order changes, design-level draft; retrospective audit PR #795)
